The Petitioner has served a copy of the Petition on the Respondents and notice regarding the filing of this Petition has been published in the newspapers in accordance with Section 64 of the Electricity Act, 2003 (the Act). No comments or suggestions have been received from the general public in response to the aforesaid notices published in the newspapers by the Petitioner. Respondent No.1, M.P. Power Management Company Limited (MPPMCL), has filed its reply vide affidavit dated 22.11.2024 and has raised the issue of non-placement of Assessment order issued by the Income Tax Department for 2019-20 and 2020-21 and Audited Accounts in respect of actual taxes paid for 2019-20 and 2020-21 and GST. The issues raised by MPPMCL have been considered in the relevant paragraphs of this order. 7. This order is issued considering the submissions made by the Petitioner in the Petition vide affidavit dated 5.8.2024, and subsequent affidavits dated 8.10.2024 and 14.11.2024, as well as the reply of MPPMCL vide affidavit dated 22.11.2024. 8. MPPMCL has submitted that the Petitioner, in many of the signed documents in its Petition, has mentioned only ‘Madhya Pradesh Power Management Company Limited’ as the Respondent. MPPMCL has further submitted that, however, there are other 10 Respondents in the instant Petition. MPPMCL has requested that wherever only ‘Madhya Pradesh Power Management Company Limited’ is mentioned as the Respondent, the same may be read as ‘M. P. Power Management Company Limited and Others.’ MPPMCL has further requested the Commission to issue necessary directions to the Petitioner to be more vigilant in this regard. 9. We have considered the MPPMCL's submissions and are of the view that wherever the Petitioner has mentioned the Respondent's name as Madhya Pradesh Power Management Company Limited, it should be read as ‘M.P. Power Management Company Limited and Others.’ Accordingly, the Petitioner is directed to read ‘Madhya Pradesh Power Management Company Limited’ as ‘M. P. Power Management Company Limited and Others’, wherever it occurred. 12. Having heard the Petitioner’s representative and perused the material available on record, we proceed to dispose of the Petition. 13. The Petitioner has claimed reimbursement of the fee paid by it for filing the Petition and on the publication expenses. The Petitioner has further submitted that it shall be entitled to the reimbursement of the filing fee and the expenses incurred on publication of notices in the application for approval of tariff directly from the beneficiaries or the long-term customers, as the case may be in accordance with Regulation 94(1) of the 2024 Tariff Regulations. 68. We have considered the Petitioner's submissions. The Petitioner is entitled to the reimbursement of the fees paid for filing the Petition and publication expenses incurred on this count directly from the beneficiaries or long-term customers, as the case may be. 85.
